selection.title: Stay In Touch
selection.description: Because 'I'll text them later' never works.

drafts.whatsapp: Be honest — you said "I'll text them later" about three people this week and haven't opened the chat since. @teni built an app about exactly that: Stay In Touch sets a rhythm of calls and reminders for the relationships you actually care about. Also new this week: @omare's Inspirational Women, a gallery tribute to the people whose discipline changed how he spends his days. And @maadandev's NextRole NG skips the fake CV scores and tells you what Nigerian recruiters really see when they read yours. Fresh builds are live on the LearnToEarn Leaderboard (l2e.lovable.app) — go try one and drop your vote, because the board resets Friday.
drafts.discord:
Quick one before the week runs away from you.

Three new builds just landed on the LearnToEarn Leaderboard (l2e.lovable.app):

**Stay In Touch** by @teni — built on the honest premise that "I'll text them later" never works. It sets a call and visit rhythm for each relationship, so the people who matter stop slipping down your list.

**Inspirational Women** by @omare — a design project that opens like a gallery: Volume I, 2026, women whose discipline and mindset changed how he decides to spend his days. Leila Hormozi on discipline is the first room. Worth entering just for the typography.

**NextRole NG** by @maadandev — a full-stack AI CV tool for the Nigerian job market. Most optimizers hand you a fake 90% score and wish you luck; this one tells you what a recruiter actually sees — "high-risk hire" — and shows you exactly what to fix.

Go try one and cast your vote this week — the leaderboard resets Friday.
